question: Training of Rural Youth for Self-Employment (TRYSEM) was initiated in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1979**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Training of Rural Youth for Self-Employment (TRYSEM)** was launched by the **Government of India** on **15th August 1979** as a centrally sponsored scheme.
 
• The primary **objective** of the scheme was to provide **technical and entrepreneurial skills** to rural youth from families living **below the poverty line (BPL)**.
